campaign: MOSS in overgo does what the MOSS Ultra workflow does in ComfyUI, each section held to ComfyUI's recording

items.title: A measurement retried at the same key runs no lanes it has passed, so a publication-only retry takes minutes, not the lanes' hours

steps.title: measurePhases keeps the lanes' pass in the cycle's state for its key and credits it on a retry, as it credits the cells and the publication
steps.rationale:
SQA-502 (P2), reopened by the review at 07a7a7185 and checked by the lead against cmd/loop/improve.go at ef97df584: valid from source. measurePhases reads the state's Cells and Published but runs the preflight and the lanes before consulting either, so a retry whose cells and publication are credited still runs the lanes, 9 h 14 min in the close of 2026-11-25. The change: the state keeps the lanes' pass for its key (the commit, the store and the obligations), and a retry at that key credits the lanes as it credits the cells, the preflight running as before since it measures nothing. The rule that the checks the cells depend on always run is narrowed to: they run once a key.

Check: TestARetryRunsNoLanesItPassed, a stand-in validate whose lanes passed and whose publication failed, run again: the lanes are not run again, the publication is.

items.title: A commit's gate runs each package suite once, the step's check before the whole tree's tests

steps.title: The invariants stage runs no ordinary package suite that the test stage runs, and the step's check runs before either
steps.rationale:
SQA-516 (P2), checked by the lead against internal/landing at ef97df584: valid from the landing records. The invariants stage runs four whole ordinary package suites before the step's verifier, and the test stage runs ./... again after it: at 692c145aa the scorecard-history fixture took 66 s of a 9 min 28 s invariants stage before a 9 s verifier; on the refused journey-attach/do attempt invariants took 215 s before a 9.7 s failure; at 6862d5287 the dispatch refusal test ran twice, 47 s and 41 s, and the trunk protection test 29 s and 35 s. A slow test run twice for one commit is the repeated testing the owner's review of 2026-11-25 named. The change: the step's check runs first, as the cheapest refusal, and a suite the test stage runs is not run by the invariants stage; what an invariant holds that ./... does not run stays. First list what each of the four suites holds that the test stage does not.

Check: TestALandingRunsEachSuiteOnce, the stages' commands for a change: no package suite in two stages, the verifier first.

decisions.question: skill.md's 227 rule lines each cite a check. Read at 3ba4de8c7: the first check of 181 has a doc comment and of 45 has none, and the comments state what their test holds, not the rule that cites it ("purpose = recursive self-improvement ..." cites TestCycleFilesDeclinesAndAcceptsNothing, whose comment is the cycle's comparisons; "scorecard columns = ..." cites TestScorecardRowsEveryServableModel, whose comment is rows and dashes). Writing skill.md from the comments as they stand changes what it says. Which form does skill.md take?
options: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
skill.md holds its terms and judgement lines alone; the rule lines go, each check saying its rule when it refuses
skill.md is written from the tests' doc comments as they stand, its wording changing to theirs
decisions.recommendation: Each rule line moves onto its first check as a doc-comment line of its own, and skill.md is generated from those lines and its judgement section, so it says what it says now, each rule written once on its check
